header.title: HOW IT WORKS
header.subtitle: Reporting a public issue takes only a few minutes. Follow these four simple steps.

describe.title: Describe the issue
describe.description: Choose a category, write a short title and add a clear photo of the problem.

locate.title: Add the location
locate.description: Enter the address or use your current location and drop a pin on the map.

submit.title: Submit the report
submit.description: Send the report and save the report ID you receive on screen.

track.title: Track the progress
track.description: Use the report ID to check the status and see when the issue is resolved.

header.title: ABOUT US
header.subtitle: A citizen platform that connects the people of our municipality with the people who can solve their problems.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Hamro Samadhan exists to make local governance visible and accountable. Many public problems go unaddressed simply because nobody reported them. We give every citizen a simple way to raise these issues, and a clear way to follow what happened next.
mission.imageAlt: Citizens working together in the community

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Every report and its progress stays open for the public to see.

community.title: Community Driven
community.description: Reports come from the people who live with the problem every day.

trust.title: Citizen Trust
trust.description: Your personal details are handled responsibly and never shown publicly.

header.title: REPORT GUIDELINES
header.subtitle: A clear report is resolved faster. Follow these simple tips to get your problem fixed.

tips.title: Before you report
tips.subtitle: Three things that make a report much easier for the right team to act on.

precise.title: Be precise
precise.description: Name the exact road, landmark or ward so the issue can be found on the first try.

photo.title: Add a clear photo
photo.description: A sharp daylight photo showing the whole problem helps far more than a description alone.

contact.title: Stay reachable
contact.description: Give a working phone number or email so officials can ask questions or confirm the fix.

do: Describe the problem in your own words
Add the photo and the exact location
Check the details before you submit
dont: Do not write rude or personal comments
Do not report the same issue many times
Do not post someone else's private information
Do not use the form for complaints about a person
